Homeworks are worth *50%* of your grade and are due **Tuesday 11 PM** every week. A late submission is worth zero points.

You are expected to put roughly **4.5 hours a week** into these problems, and to
evaluate each other's effort claims.

You can also checkout [Jia's Homework Solutions](https://github.com/bhargavajia/Dynamics-Simulation-HW) and [Tanay's Homework Solutions](https://github.com/tanayrs/IntermediateDynamics) from the Plaksha 2025 version of this course. The same problems have been prescribed to the Plaksha 2026, some changes maybe done as the course continues.

## Other materials in the solution sets

These files sit in the solution folders but are not referenced by any problem
number in the master sheet — old exam questions, extra write-ups and the like.
They are listed here so nothing gets lost.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
blocks = []
for label, items in other.items():
    if not items:
        continue
    blocks.append(f"**{label}** — {len(items)} file(s)\n")
    lis = []
    for it in items:
        warn = ' <span class="warn" title="Not instructor-reviewed">⚠</span>' if not it["approved"] else ""
        sub = f' <span class="muted">({it["subfolder"]})</span>' if it["subfolder"] else ""
        lis.append(f'<li>{S.link(it["file"], it["name"])}{warn}{sub}</li>')
    blocks.append('<ul class="other-materials">' + "".join(lis) + "</ul>\n")
print("\n".join(blocks) if blocks else "_Nothing unmapped — every file is linked from the table above._")
```

A ⚠ marks a solution that has **not** been reviewed by the instructor: use it as a hint, not as a model answer.
